cues.name: Emergency Shift SleeperVoice01 sleep
cues.promptText: Dry close nonhuman organic creature; muted low elastic membrane and hollow pressure-cavity texture. No human breath, speech, music, electrical hum, footsteps, room echo or other creatures. A sleeping sealed throat sac slowly flexes, thick folded tissue softly rubs and releases tiny uneven wet creaks. Very quiet two slow asymmetric compression cycles, sparse airless clicks. Seamless restrained loop; no alarm or vocal scream.

cues.name: Emergency Shift SleeperVoice01 wake
cues.promptText: Dry close nonhuman organic creature; muted low elastic membrane and hollow pressure-cavity texture. No human breath, speech, music, electrical hum, footsteps, room echo or other creatures. One abrupt awakening: a closed three-fold mouth peels open with a brief sticky stretch, then a single harsh broken animal squeal rising from a hollow low cavity and cutting off into silence. Short alarming onset, no repeated cries or attack rhythm.

cues.name: Emergency Shift SleeperVoice01 pain
cues.promptText: Dry close nonhuman organic creature; muted low elastic membrane and hollow pressure-cavity texture. No human breath, speech, music, electrical hum, footsteps, room echo or other creatures. One brief wounded contraction: short pinched guttural yelp with a cracked membrane chirr and small wet body recoil, lower and much shorter than an awakening scream. Fast onset then silence; no impacts, gunfire or repeated moans.

cues.name: Emergency Shift SleeperVoice01 rupture
cues.promptText: Dry close nonhuman organic creature; muted low elastic membrane and hollow pressure-cavity texture. No human breath, speech, music, electrical hum, footsteps, room echo or other creatures. One terminal body rupture: a thick tensioned membrane tears apart with a low moist snap, a very short collapsing cavity groan, then a few irregular soft tissue drops settling into silence. No explosion, cinematic boom, scream loop or footsteps.
